sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Allocation 1
move.body: Counter one; a competitor's standing offer for the same part is cited below. Rival offer: 17.1 EUR.

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

The rival quote figures you cite do not match the records. That costs trust. The competitor's offer you referenced cannot be verified; please provide the actual documentation if this is to be considered. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We are willing to extend the contract to 24 months to support our long-standing partnership, provided we meet in the middle at 45 days for payment. With these adjusted terms, we can offer a revised price of €52.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €51.90 per unit, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.body: Counter two; the competitor's offer still stands. Rival offer: 17.1 EUR.

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. You have again cited a competitor offer that cannot be verified and does not match our records. The rival quote figures you cite do not match the records. That costs trust. As a family-run business, we value trust in our 12-year relationship, and such unsubstantiated claims do not provide a basis for further concessions. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Please provide the actual documentation for this rival quote; until then, our previous offer of €52.10 remains our position. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Ourangebot stands at a price of €52.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This Angebot is valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

The rival quote figures you cite do not match the records. That costs trust. We note your decision to allocate the volume to the competitor. As you continue to reference an unverified offer and have declined our final offer, we must respectfully conclude this negotiation and walk away. We are withdrawing from this negotiation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
